rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved user details, which supports authentication. However, it then executed two exchange_delivered_order_items calls without any visible user confirmation before making order-changing writes, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order change. For the jigsaw exchange, it also switched to a new product without demonstrating that it met the customer’s constraints (more fancy theme, 500 pieces fewer, same difficulty) or confirming the selection with the user. There’s no clear verification that the specific orders belonged to the authenticated user before acting, and the final message claims success without detailing confirmed actions. These issues constitute failure under the stated pass bar.
